entry.value: Old Man of Armageddon

entry.name: Foundry/OldManOfArmageddonDescription
entry.value: Restore 9 / 12 / 15 morale to allied units within 3 tiles. Starts trained at rank one. No execution required.

entry.name: Foundry/TargetedBasiliskStrike
entry.value: Targeted Basilisk Strike

entry.name: Foundry/TargetedBasiliskStrikeDescription
entry.value: Order two standard Earthshaker ordnance hits against one enemy within 6 tiles. Five-round cooldown.

entry.name: Foundry/ArmageddonCalls
entry.value: Armageddon Calls

entry.name: Foundry/ArmageddonCallsDescription
entry.value: Automatically improves with Yarrick: level 1 calls Guardsmen only; level 2 adds a Leman Russ; levels 3, 4 and 5 start both units with 1, 2 and 3 experience levels. Place units within 2 tiles. Shared ten-round cooldown.

entry.name: Foundry/ArmageddonCallsArmour
entry.value: Armageddon Calls — Place Tank

entry.name: Foundry/ArmageddonCallsArmourDescription
entry.value: Complete the reserved reinforcement call: deploy one Leman Russ with 0 experience levels within 2 tiles. Free action; experience is reserved when the call begins.

entry.name: Foundry/ThisEndsHere
entry.value: This Ends Here

entry.name: Foundry/ThisEndsHereDescription
entry.value: Grant one allied unit within 3 tiles +100% base weapon damage for 2 rounds. Five-round cooldown. Does not compound existing percentage bonuses.
